english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a hostile person, opposing group, or enemy force.
Use this instead of 對手 when the adversary is a hostile enemy who attacks or is engaged in a serious conflict.

examples.english: On the battlefield, the adversary suddenly attacked from behind.
examples.traditional: 戰場上，敵人突然由後面殺出嚟。
